chunks: Tell: O mankind, I am only for you a clear warner.
ai.seo_question: What is the role of the Prophet as a clear warner in Surah Al-Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet's role as a clear warner (nathir) who announces the consequences of disbelief and obedience, emphasizing the clarity and directness of the prophetic mission to all people. It highlights the universality of the message, aligning with the Shia understanding of the Prophet's guidance as a divine trust delivered without alteration to the entire humanity.
